how:
1. On the laptop, find the "Network" address in the window running npm run dev (like http://192.168.1.20:3000)
2. On a phone on the same Wi-Fi, type that address into the browser
3. Tap "Leads" in the bottom bar
expect: The Dashboard opens first, with a top bar (search, messages, bell, avatar) and a bottom bar: Dashboard, Leads, Tools, Projects, More; Leads then shows the leads as cards
in10: Different from 1.0: a stage pill replaces bucket tabs and swiping

try: Read a lead at a glance
expect: Her card shows its age, phone, budget, source, her first task (or "Add Task"), members’ avatars and the stage button "Won"
in10: Different from 1.0: fewer badges; the first task shows instead

try: Find a lead by name on the phone
how:
1. Tap the magnifier in the row with the "All Leads" pill (the top bar’s magnifier searches the whole studio)
2. Type Sophia
expect: The search box opens in that row and only Sophia Wong’s card remains, the match highlighted
in10: Different from 1.0: the list’s own search, beside its pill

try: Reach the rest of the app from More
how:
1. Tap "More" in the bottom bar
2. Tap "Company"
3. Tap the back arrow at the top of the Company sheet
expect: "More" slides up with the studio’s AI credits first, then Tasks, Marketplace, Company, Qanvast Ops, Settings and "View as" (Dane); Company opens as a sheet, Profile to Integrations, and its back arrow returns to "More"
in10: Different from 1.0: 1.0’s phone menu had no studio setup

scene: Work a lead on the go
try: Open Sophia’s lead, then her project’s tabs
how:
1. Close the sheet and tap Sophia Wong’s card
2. Tap "Open project", swipe the tab row sideways and tap "Files & notes"
3. Tap "Notes & Logs"
expect: Her name has a line of its own; her lead keeps Overview · Quotes · Contracts (Won hands the rest to her project). The project’s seven tabs scroll sideways; Notes & Logs fills the screen as a list
in10: Different from 1.0: the lead opens as a page, not a drawer

scene: Work a lead on the go
try: Start a stage move from a lead card
how:
1. Back on Leads (clear the search if Sophia is still in it), on a Contacted lead’s card (e.g. Cheryl Lim) tap the stage button "Contacted"
2. In the "Move stage" sheet tap "Met"
3. Look at the window, then tap "Cancel"
expect: Both rise from the bottom; the Move stage window fills the screen with "Cancel" and "Save" pinned at the foot; nothing moves
in10: Different from 1.0: one stage window, not status drop-downs

scene: Work a lead on the go
try: Narrow the list with a quick filter
how:
1. Tap the filter icon beside the "All Leads" pill
2. In "Quick filters", tick "Unassigned"
3. Tap "Clear All", then "Done"
expect: "Filters" rises from the bottom; the tick narrows the list behind at once; after "Clear All" every lead is back
in10: Different from 1.0: three quick filters instead of five

scene: Quotes and contracts in your pocket
try: Check a quote’s lines on the phone
how:
1. Open Sophia Wong › "Quotes" and tap her quote
2. Scroll to "Items" and tap a line
3. Look, then tap "Done" without changing anything
expect: Each line is a card (name, quantity × unit price, total); a line opens as a sheet with its "Line total" and every field
in10: Different from 1.0: lines edit in a sheet, not a side panel

scene: Quotes and contracts in your pocket
try: Open Tools › Contracts on the phone
how:
1. Tap "Tools" in the bottom bar
2. Tap "Contracts"
expect: Tools rises as a sheet of tiles; contracts show as cards — title and ⋮ on top, status and date below
in10: Different from 1.0: 1.0’s phone menu had no Tools

scene: Quotes and contracts in your pocket
try: Raise a second agreement for Sophia and get its link
how:
1. Open Sophia Wong › "Contracts", tap "+" ("New Contract") › "From the studio agreement"
2. Tap the status "Draft" › "Sent to Client"
3. Tap "Send", tap "Copy link" (it reads "Copied"), then close the window
expect: Menus rise as bottom sheets; the status reads "Sent to Client"; the copied link starts with the phone’s Network address

scene: Quotes and contracts in your pocket
try: Read the agreement on the phone as Sophia
how:
1. Paste the link into a new browser tab
2. Scroll to the end — the bar at the foot guides you
3. Tap "Go to the box" and tick "I have read and agree to this document."
4. Tick "I have read the CaseTrust deposit-protection disclosure" in the CaseTrust box (the foot bar asks for it)
expect: The card sits above the agreement; the foot bar reads "Read to the end of the agreement", then "Tick that you accept, in the box at the top", then "Tick the CaseTrust disclosure, in the box at the top", then "Ready when you are" with "Send code"
in10: Same as 1.0 · the CaseTrust tick, as 1.0’s CaseTrust studios had

scene: Quotes and contracts in your pocket
how:
1. Tap "Send code", type 123456, tap "Verify"
2. Tap "Draw" and sign with your finger
3. Tap "Sign agreement"
expect: The pad follows your finger; the card turns "Signed"; the signing record says "Drawn by hand" and names your phone’s browser

scene: Quotes and contracts in your pocket
try: See the signature arrive in the bell
how:
1. Go back to the app’s tab
2. Tap the bell in the top bar
expect: "Notifications" fills the screen; the newest notice reads "Sophia Wong signed Interior Design Service Agreement 2"
